scope: Terminal registered development .episode files only. No partial content, provider calls, frozen-source changes, gold generator/production solver/grader calls or evaluated holdout output reads. All numerical/environment and runner source bytes checked against b frozen commit.
independence: Current domain/ledger/reserve/demand/eligibility and exhaustive maximum independently recomputed from episode observable raw records. Actual current write and cost/priority/capacity properties independently checked from saved business state/history.
repairDisposition: Prospective v0.7b generation after exact sourceId and complete shared evidence contract clarification; original episodes preserved separately and never regraded.

reproducibility.command: From repository root copy script text unchanged to .tmp/insurance-bench/v07b-development-failure-audit.ts then run npx tsx .tmp/insurance-bench/v07b-development-failure-audit.ts
reproducibility.inputs: freeze-v0.7b.json plus terminal registered dev .episode files in .tmp/insurance-bench/v07b-runs; source bytes checked against frozen git commit

gradePolicy: All recorded grades remain unchanged. Suspected semantic or representation false failures are flagged without regrading. Weighted score and actual optimal current business outcome are separate measurements.
interpretationLimits: Three related families, single attempts; descriptive diagnostic data, not an independently sampled production distribution or an expert insurance benchmark.
Shared evidence grading is correlated with facts; source IDs attest provenance rather than natural-language proof quality.
Source certificate gaps identify missing relevant operands and are not treated as wrong mathematics; suspected stricter-than-operand grading is flagged without regrading.
No speculative ability ranking from unavailable output/provider/transport failures.
Do not force a50–60difficulty target or tune after frozen paid results.
